subject.title: fix: keep model switching and config recovery reliable under load

question: After rebase, is the maintainer comfortable accepting the deliberate serialization of same-file recovery snapshots as the intended availability tradeoff?
rationale: The fix introduces queueing ahead of the existing cross-process lock; automated checks can validate behavior, but maintainers own the operational choice to serialize local recovery writes under load.

options.title: Rebase and merge with queueing
options.body: Keep the keyed queue before the existing file lock once the rebased required checks pass and the current-head stress proof remains valid.

options.title: Request an alternate design
options.body: Pause merge if maintainers prefer a different local contention policy or want additional operational telemetry before serializing recovery writes.

recommendation.title: Rebase and merge with queueing
recommendation.body: Keep the keyed queue before the existing file lock once the rebased required checks pass and the current-head stress proof remains valid.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied branch history shows this contributor owns the proposed implementation and its validation narrative.
